Title: Book an available vehicle
Preconditions: Employee logged in; vehicle v-001 available
Steps: 1. Go to Bookings 2. Select v-001 3. Enter valid date range 4. Submit

Title: Book an already reserved vehicle
Preconditions: Vehicle has an overlapping approved booking
Steps: 1. Select same vehicle 2. Enter overlapping dates 3. Submit
Expected Result: 409 Conflict; booking rejected with a clear error

Title: Request a vehicle without specifying dates
Steps: 1. Submit booking form with no dates

Title: Request a vehicle for an invalid date range
Steps: 1. Set end date before start date 2. Submit

Title: Approve a booking
Preconditions: Fleet manager logged in; booking is pending
Expected Result: Status changes to 'approved'; vehicle status becomes 'reserved'

Title: Reject a booking
Preconditions: Fleet manager logged in; booking is pending
Expected Result: Status changes to 'rejected' with a reason

Title: Concurrent overlapping bookings (double booking)
Priority: 1. Fire two near-simultaneous booking requests via JMeter
column7: Exactly one booking succeeds; the other returns 409
